title: Emotion Sharing Protocols Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Emotion Sharing Protocols: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Emotion Sharing Protocols — protocols transmitting emotional states.

Phase 1 — Prove (affect codecs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (protocol logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (emotional consent): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (abuse guards): protocol hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and neurotech-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
